description: Test suite for ArrayUtils, testing equality, subarray search, binary search algorithms, and endian conversions.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Tests equality comparison between arrays and Uint8Arrays.

methods.name: searchSubarray
methods.description: Tests searching for a subarray within an array.

methods.name: binarySearchFirstGreaterOrEqual
methods.description: Tests binary search for first element greater than or equal to a target.

methods.name: binarySearchFirstGreater
methods.description: Tests binary search for first element strictly greater than a target.

methods.name: toUintLittleEndian
methods.description: Tests conversion of byte arrays to unsigned integer values in little-endian format.

methods.name: toIntLittleEndian
methods.description: Tests conversion of byte arrays to signed integer values in little-endian format.
